notes.text: Yosef asks Rabbi Abbahu about saving the books of Bei Avidan from a fire, an exchange also cited by [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2015&lang=en). The Midrash names Rabbi Nachman bar Chanin. These are separate attestations of the patronymic.
